title: AI-Assisted Metagenomics Analysis
text:
Explore processed taxonomic and functional profiles with Python. Start with synthetic practice, verify the outputs, and explain what the evidence supports.






One workflow for every dataset




Define the question.
Preview the results.
Meet the inputs.
Check the inputs.
Run the analysis.
Verify and explain.
Write the report, showing the results that support your statements and explaining what the analysis cannot establish.



Start with Required setup, then Synthetic practice. The hypertension section awaits verified real profiles and study documentation.

title: Required setup
text: Follow steps 1–2 in the project README. Run all commands in a terminal from the main project folder. Quarto is only needed to preview or render the guide and report.

title: Start here
text:
Question: How do microbial composition, Shannon diversity, and relative functional profiles vary between groups?
Use the synthetic data to practise the full workflow. Differences were constructed for teaching.

title: See the result
text:
Synthetic taxonomic composition





Synthetic sample diversity


Group A has a higher median Shannon diversity and less variation than Group B, although the groups overlap. All samples contain eight detected taxa, so the diversity differences reflect how evenly abundance is distributed among taxa. This plot alone does not establish statistical significance.



Synthetic functional profile


Describe visible differences. These figures do not establish statistical significance or causation.

title: Meet the data
text: Read the input contract in README. Inspect all three TSV files. Identify groups, sample IDs, abundance units, taxonomic resolution, and functional feature definitions. The functional labels are invented and cannot be assigned pathway names.

title: Check the inputs
text:
Run the checks before analysis:
python scripts/python/run_workflow.py --data-dir data/synthetic --output-dir results/synthetic --check-only
Resolve every reported problem. Automatic checks do not establish study design validity or biological suitability.

title: Run the analysis
text:
Run from the main project folder:
python scripts/python/run_workflow.py --data-dir data/synthetic --output-dir results/synthetic
Review the figures and saved tables. The analysis is descriptive; functional profiles represent relative potential, not activity.

title: Verify and explain
text:
Choose a sample ID from your metadata (start with S01). Recalculate its taxon total, detected taxa and natural-log Shannon diversity:
python scripts/python/verify_sample.py data/synthetic results/synthetic S01
Compare the manual values with the saved results. Explain Shannon using richness and evenness. Then write one observation per figure, checking values in the tables. State limitations and a useful follow-up check.

title: Export the report
text:
Edit reports/synthetic-report.qmd and replace every prompt with checked results and your own explanation.
quarto render reports/synthetic-report.qmd --to html
Report the question, inputs and units, methods, checked findings, and limitations. Do not claim significance or causation from visuals alone.

text: Figure 15.1: Taxonomic composition across samples, calculated from synthetic placeholder abundances. Each bar represents one sample.

title: Verify and explain
text:
Shannon diversity






Figure 15.2: Shannon diversity calculated from the placeholder taxon table. Each dot represents one sample; black lines indicate group medians.



Compare group medians, spread and overlap. Use the saved detected_taxa values to explain whether richness, evenness or both contribute to the differences. Keep these calculated values separate from source_shannon_index in the metadata. This plot alone does not establish statistical significance.

title: Verify and explain
text:
Functional profile






Figure 15.3: Within-sample proportions of the supplied functional features. Each bar represents one sample; remaining features are combined as Other.



Identify the largest displayed proportions and check them against the saved table. These proportions describe only the supplied feature set. Interpretation remains provisional until the feature definitions, source and measurement units are confirmed.

title: Appendix A — Appendix
text:
Shannon diversity
For positive taxon proportions \(p_i\), \(H=-\sum_i p_i\ln(p_i)\). Zero proportions contribute zero. Detected taxa count features with abundance greater than zero. Total abundance is the sum of the supplied units, not necessarily read depth.

title: Appendix A — Appendix
text:
Functional profiles
Feature abundance, pathway abundance, and pathway coverage have different meanings. Confirm the source units and feature definitions before deciding whether within-sample normalization is appropriate. This starter requires an abundance-like matrix with positive sample totals.
